transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today? Is there something specific you’d like to talk about or get help with?

Yeah, um… I guess I’m here because I’ve just been really, really tired. Like, probably more than I should be. My body feels kind of completely drained lately—like even just walking from my car into the clinic took a lot out of me, and at work even opening the EHR feels like it takes everything I have. I don’t know if that makes sense, but… I figured I should probably get help with it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has the fatigue been constant or does it come and go?

Um… I’m not exactly sure when it started, honestly. It’s been going on long enough that I felt like I should come in, but I don’t want to make it sound dramatic or anything.

It feels pretty constant lately, though. Like my body just feels completely drained most of the time. Even small stuff—walking in from my car, or sitting down at work and trying to open the EHR—feels like it takes everything I have. Is that… the kind of thing you mean?
Can you estimate how long this fatigue has been going on? Has it been weeks, months, or longer?

I’m sorry, I don’t have a really exact timeline. I think it’s been… at least long enough that it stopped feeling like just a bad day or two, if that makes sense. Lately it’s been pretty constant—my body just feels drained, like even walking from the car into here or opening the EHR at work takes everything I’ve got. I know that’s not a very precise answer.
Can you give me a rough idea of how long you’ve been feeling this way—like weeks, months, or more than that?

I guess… if I’m being honest, it’s been more like months. Around nine months, maybe. It kind of started after I… crashed after this really high-energy stretch, and since then it’s been this depressed, guilty, exhausted feeling. I probably should’ve said that more clearly before—sorry.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

I’m not totally sure. I mean, I still kind of try to do the usual things, but I don’t know if I’d say I’m enjoying them the same way. Maybe I haven’t really paid attention to that specifically.

Is that what you mean—like whether things feel fun anymore?
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies, time with friends, or things you looked forward to?

Yeah… I think maybe a little, but I’m not totally sure how much. I still do some things I used to do, so I don’t want to make it sound like I’ve completely stopped caring or anything. It’s more like… I don’t look forward to them the same way, maybe? But I don’t know if that counts.
Have you felt down, sad, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past several months?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but after all that energy kind of dropped off, I started feeling really empty most days. Sad, hopeless, I guess.

A lot of the time it feels like I’ve already messed up my future in healthcare before it even really started. I know that probably sounds extreme, but… yeah, it’s been there most days.
Have you been feeling guilty or like you’re a failure more days than not, even when things aren’t necessarily your fault?

Yeah… I guess I have. I try not to make it a big thing, because my supervisors have told me nothing bad happened, but I keep going back over every chart I did, every set of vitals, like… what if I missed something or hurt someone somehow?

Even when they say it was okay, I still feel like I failed or did something wrong. I know that might not make sense, but it’s hard to shake.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating more or less than usual or losing or gaining a noticeable amount of weight?

Um… yeah, a little. I don’t think I was trying to not eat or anything, it just… food didn’t really sound good.

I’d skip lunch and sometimes dinner too, and then realize I’d mostly just had coffee or water all day. I noticed my scrubs were kind of hanging looser on me, so I guess I probably did lose some weight. I don’t know exactly how much, though.
Have you had trouble sleeping recently, like waking up early or not being able to fall asleep, or on the flip side, have you found yourself sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah… my sleep’s been kind of all over the place.

For a while I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours and still felt like I had energy, like I didn’t really need more. I know that probably sounds bad, but at the time it didn’t feel like a problem.

Lately it’s more the opposite, or just… not normal. I’ll wake up really early, before dawn, already worried and feeling kind of sick, or I’ll sleep half the day and still feel exhausted. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed that your movements have slowed down or that you can't sit still—like you're moving slower than usual or, on the flip side, you feel restless and can't stay still?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I didn’t really notice it at first, or I thought I was just tired.

But people at work said I looked kind of slowed down, and… I could feel it too. Like even putting a blood pressure cuff away or answering someone’s question took me way longer than it normally would. It’s embarrassing, honestly. I wasn’t trying to be difficult or anything.
Have you had episodes of depression like this before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way for such an extended period?

I mean… I’ve had down periods before, I guess, but not like this. This has been going on a lot longer than I want to admit.

After that really high-energy stretch ended, I kind of crashed, and the depressed, guilty, exhausted part has been… maybe about nine months now. That sounds like a lot when I say it out loud. Is that the kind of timeline you mean?
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had similar symptoms that lasted for weeks or months and affected your daily life?

Yeah… I think I kind of already touched on it, but yes.

After that really high-energy period ended, I just sort of crashed. And the down part — feeling guilty and exhausted and not like myself — has been going on for about nine months now. I guess I kept telling myself it wasn’t that bad, or that I’d snap out of it, but it has affected things day to day.

Is that what you mean?
